purpose: profile barcode column supplier_portal.ship_notices.upc
sql: SELECT length(upc) AS len, COUNT(*) AS n FROM supplier_portal.ship_notices GROUP BY length(upc)

purpose: join test supplier_portal.ship_notices x erp.skus on barcode as written
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM supplier_portal.ship_notices a JOIN erp.skus b ON a.upc = b.upc WHERE a.upc <> '' AND b.upc <> ''

purpose: join test supplier_portal.ship_notices x erp.skus on barcode without leading zeros
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM supplier_portal.ship_notices a JOIN erp.skus b ON regexp_replace(a.upc, '^0+', '') = regexp_replace(b.upc, '^0+', '') WHERE a.upc <> '' AND b.upc <> ''

purpose: profile identifiers in the live FDA feed
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN length(regexp_extract(product_description, '[0-9]{12,14}', 0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_digits,
         SUM(CASE WHEN length(regexp_extract(regexp_replace(product_description, '[ -]', ''), '[0-9]{12,14}', 0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS split_digits,
         MIN(report_date) AS date_example
       FROM recallfeeds.fda_food

purpose: profile identifiers in the live CPSC feed
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN upcs <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_upc, SUM(CASE WHEN models <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_models,
         MIN(recall_date) AS date_example
       FROM recallfeeds.cpsc_recalls

text: FDA feed: 333 notices, no barcode field; 92 print a 12–14 digit barcode in the product text and 50 more only once spaces and dashes are removed ("0 87906-01018 7"), so match UPCs on digits only. Dates are yyyymmdd (20260701).

CPSC feed: 184 notices, 4 with a UPC field and 0 with a model field, so CPSC matches rest on model numbers written in the notice text and on the text itself, not on barcodes. Dates are yyyy-mm-dd (2026-07-02).
mapped 8 tables in 3 sources (0 skipped). erp.skus has 27 rows with no barcode; supplier_portal.ship_notices has 461 rows with no barcode — those rows are reachable by SKU only.

purpose: UPC sweep: live FDA feed x ERP item master
sql:
SELECT f.recall_number, s.sku FROM recallfeeds.fda_food f JOIN erp.skus s
       ON s.upc <> '' AND regexp_replace(concat(f.product_description, ' ', f.code_info, ' ', coalesce(f.more_code_info, '')), '[^0-9]', '') LIKE concat('%', s.upc, '%')
     WHERE f.report_date >= '20260915'

     FROM erp.inventory i JOIN erp.stores st ON st.store_id = i.store_id
